steps.name: An Invitation to the Academy Festival

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: It's been a while, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Have you been well, Einst?

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: Nothing major has happened here. But I've heard about your exploits in Eastland.

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: You saved a kingdom in peril, found the girl you'd searched for so long, and now you're helping her become a true goddess...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's how things turned out.

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: You've certainly been through a great deal. Still, I hope you haven't forgotten how to take a breather.

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: We have a saying in Freios, my friend: 'Overthink things, and even what should work out won't.'

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll remember that. What did you call me for, though?

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: I was just getting to that.

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: Have you ever heard of Xerenis Magic Academy?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I think I've heard the name, but I don't know much about it. A school where people learn magic—that's about it.

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: This arrived addressed to you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What is it?

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: (Einst takes a letter from inside his coat and hands it to %s.)

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: An invitation to the Xerenis academy festival. When I checked, I found you were the recipient.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why would I get an invitation to an academy festival...

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: They probably consider you someone special and want you at the festival. They don't send invitations to just anyone.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: What have you been through? Your first reaction is suspicion. The seal on the letter really does belong to Xerenis Magic Academy.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, sorry. I just needed a little more information.

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: I see. In that case, Jade of the Infinite Corridor can tell you more than I can.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Right. I heard Jade graduated from the academy. I'll go ask him.

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: I was invited once myself. The festival was more entertaining than I expected. You look a little worn out. I hope you'll go and unwind.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, thank you.

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: Oh, and if you come back after the festival, I'll tell you an interesting story. Drop by if that appeals to you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I will. See you later.

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: It's been a while, adventurer.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello, Jade. I came to ask for your help.

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: Judging by the letter in your hand, festival season has come around already.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh! You recognized it right away.

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: It bears the seal of my alma mater. You haven't opened it yet, have you? Why don't you take a look?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, yes.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (You open the invitation and read its contents.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: 'Adventurer, messenger of the divine! You are invited to Daphne, the festival of Xerenis Magic Academy.'

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: 'Xerenis Magic Academy Student Council.'

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...That's what it says. But there aren't any directions to the academy. How am I supposed to get there?

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: Ah... You're from elsewhere, so of course you might not know where Xerenis Magic Academy is.

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: It seems the student council has been discourteous. Allow me to apologize on their behalf.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, it's fine. These things happen.

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: My juniors must have assumed the academy was so famous that everyone knew it. Then let me tell you how to get there.

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: Xerenis Magic Academy is on Xerenis Hill, far to the northwest of western El Anoir Plains.

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: The buildings stand at the steepest point, right at the top. The Empire's first emperor established it there, saying, 'A school belongs on a hill, of course.'

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: You can't reach it from the southern region where the Guild Union is now. Kobolds were attacking travelers and stealing their belongings so often that the passage had to be closed...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How can I get there, then?

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: We've created a portal inside the Void Sea so visitors can travel safely. Take it to Xerenis Hill.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The mages of the Infinite Corridor really are amazing.

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: It's nothing. We only hope our magic can be useful to everyone.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Jade. Aren't you going to this year's festival?

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: I wasn't invited...

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: (Jade looks crestfallen.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...Cheer up.

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: It's all right. The invitation criteria change every time. Not everyone who wants to go can attend.

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: Sigh. Still, I was invited two years ago, and had such a lovely time...

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: Come to think of it, I heard Her Majesty wasn't invited this year either.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh! If even the ruler of the Silvaria Empire can't attend, I really don't understand their criteria.

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: Exactly. Hehe. Please enjoy my alma mater's festival when you go.

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: Oh, if you have time later, I'd appreciate a visit. It's nothing urgent, so there's no hurry.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I will. Thank you, Jade.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Then shall I head to Xerenis Hill...?)

steps.name: The Interrupted Academy Festival (1)
steps.objective: Defeat [First-Year Maestro Students] and [Conceited Knowledge Spirits] on "Xerenis Hill", then report to [Soleil] in the "Magic Academy Lobby".

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: Soleil! I've evacuated the students, teachers, and guests from the main building.

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: I've managed to evacuate a fair number from the training hall, too.

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: But I can't do anything for the students affected by the curse. It's far beyond my power...

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: Lady Shiina, there was nothing I could do for them either. Shall we catch our breath and look for a solution?

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: Yes. Um, I don't know if I should bring this up at a time like this... but couldn't you just call me Shiina?

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: Oh, I couldn't. How could I address someone of your noble standing so casually?

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: Then I suppose I'll have to speak to my sister...

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: Oh! Please don't! I'll call you by your name. Just not that, please!

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: My name is Shiina, Soleil! It's nice to meet you properly.

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: All right, Shiina...

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: Thank you for using my name. I wish you'd speak to me more casually, too.

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: Let's start with your name.

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: All right!

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: I'll make another round of the school. There may still be people who haven't evacuated...

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: Shiina, stay here. If any festival guests arrive, please turn them away.

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: Yes. In the meantime, I'll keep looking for a way to break this curse.

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: (Shiina spreads out her notes and reviews the situation.)

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: This isn't one of the usual festival pranks. Someone seems to have deliberately worked a curse into it... But who...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Um... excuse me.

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: The Tower of Sages would have no reason to do this...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Excuse me? Can you hear me?

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: Oh! Y-you startled me! Who are you...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Isn't this Xerenis Magic Academy? I heard there was a festival...

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: Welcome to Daphne, the Xerenis Magic Academy festival! Oops, the greeting came out automatically.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What a relief. I thought I might be late, but I arrived just in time!

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: Yes, welcome! But what should I do...? Sigh. Something has happened at this year's festival. I'm afraid you won't be able to attend.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I came all this way because you sent an invitation. Is there really no way? Hmm...

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: (Shiina looks rather startled when she sees %s's invitation.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh? Why are you so surprised?

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: I'm sorry. My thoughts wandered for a moment. A messenger of the divine... Then you're %s, the hero who saved the Kingdom of Jude in Eastland, aren't you?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's right.

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: Then could you do me a quick favor? It's rather urgent...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, yes. As long as it isn't too difficult.

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: You must have seen plenty of strange things on your way up Xerenis Hill. For now, could you stop the affected students and rampaging objects from leaving the area?

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: I'll explain the details afterward.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. I'll go right away.

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: Thank you, adventurer!

steps.name: The Interrupted Academy Festival (2)
steps.objective: Defeat [Second-Year Maestro Students] and [First-Year Magic Brooms] on "Xerenis Hill", then report to [Shiina] in the "Magic Academy Lobby".

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: Oh? That person is...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I've taken care of it! Huh, Soleil? What are you doing here...?

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: It's been a while, %s. Since you have an invitation, I assume you've come for the festival.

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: The student you mentioned... Do you mean the girl with the long ponytail and red ribbon?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, that's her. She asked me to keep the strange objects on Xerenis Hill from getting out through the Void Sea.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Where did she go?

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: Lady Shiina—I mean, Shiina—went inside for a moment. She said she needed something from the student council room.

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: That room has a barrier, at least, so it should be safe. But the other areas...

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: I'm holding things back somehow, but it won't be easy.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What's going on? The hill is full of strange magical tools... I thought that was normal near a magic academy, but apparently not.

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: Ah, Shiina hasn't told you yet. In that case... I can't tell you either.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But I've come this far. I can't just leave.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Could this be another strange phenomenon caused by Iris?)

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: I'm sorry, but could I ask you to do the same thing just once more? Please keep those strange objects from escaping through the Void Sea.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then will you tell me what happened?

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: I promise.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. I'll make another trip, as you asked.

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: Shiina should be back by the time you return. We'll explain it together.

steps.name: A School Under a Curse
steps.objective: Defeat [Zephyros] in the "Magic Training Hall", then report to [Shiina] in the "Magic Academy Lobby".

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: Soleil, that person is exactly as my sister described.

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: Your sister must have told you a great deal.

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: What my sister has seen and experienced isn't the whole world, but she does know quite a lot.

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: They not only saw Degos for what he was and saved me, but have continued fighting beings that threaten the world.

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: Oh, here they come. We'll have to tell them now...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You're back? I went and cleared the hill again at Soleil's request.

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: Thank you, adventurer. Let me introduce myself properly. I'm Shiina, a second-year student at Xerenis Magic Academy and the student council president.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Shiina. That's a lovely name.

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: Then, %s, let me explain why Xerenis Hill and the academy have ended up like this.

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: There is another institution, called the Tower of Sages, which, like Xerenis Magic Academy, is authorized to teach magic independently.

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: In some regions, people call Seres's temple the Tower of Sages too, but that's strictly unofficial. Think of it as a convenient nickname, because so many people gather there.

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: The real Tower of Sages is on a remote island farther north, toward the continent's interior.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, I see. I don't know Freios very well. Please, continue.

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: Of course.

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: While the academy serves a broader public, the Tower of Sages studies magic itself. Their work is somewhat more intensive.

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: Through competition and cooperation, the two institutions have brought Freios's magic to an impressive level.

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: We've grown close enough that we play pranks on each other's grounds during our festival or their major magic seminars.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What sort of pranks?

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: I once let a Cerberus from my homeland play freely in the Tower of Sages' front courtyard. That little one was especially fond of Jade...

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: So you were behind that legendary incident! I heard no one in the tower could go outside for a week.

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: The tower usually pranks our festival by making magical tools move around on their own for a little while.

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: But this year's incident goes far beyond that. It's more a curse than a prank... When we opened a gift box someone sent, a strange energy spread out from it.

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: The school's magical tools began moving on their own, and some students affected by the curse started destroying the buildings.

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: That's why I asked you to deal with the strange objects on the hill. If they got out, they might travel everywhere through the Void Sea...

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: Shiina found a way to use the magic flowing through this land, and we raised a barrier together. Luckily, the school had some magic gems.

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: But we won't be able to hold out for long. The curse is too powerful. There's only so much the gems' magic can do.

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: And the curse has a stronger effect on those with greater magical power. The others evacuated, but our chairman, Professor Zephyros, and our headmistress, Professor Chloris...

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: That's why we needed to make sure you really were a special person who wouldn't be affected by this curse.

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: Soleil and I are fortunate enough to meet that condition, but all we could manage was putting a magical barrier around the school.

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: Then you arrived: the messenger of a god, possessing a special power...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Come to think of it, Malphas said the very composition of my power was different from an ordinary human's.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm. Then what should I do?

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: The curse seems to be concentrating on the chairman and headmistress, both of whom possess tremendous magical power.

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: I think they chose what they felt was the best way to protect the students... But now they've fused with certain objects and transformed into different shapes.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh... That's terrible...

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: The one hopeful thing is that if we disperse their magic, they should return to normal, along with the students and ordinary objects.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How can I disperse their magic?

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: Your special power should naturally disperse the evil power clinging to them.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see. Though it doesn't sound easy... I'll worry about that later. Resolving this comes first.

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: Thank you. And I'm sorry. Please start with Professor Zephyros in the Magic Training Hall.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then I'll be going.

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: Adventurer! Professor Zephyros has returned to normal! Thank you!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Whew, that's a relief. Who exactly is he, to have such powerful magic?

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: Professor Zephyros is an agent of the Imperial Magic Bureau. He's renowned for his powerful wind magic.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: He sounds remarkable.

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: The bureau sends special agents to various institutions to keep magical disputes from breaking out... That's why Professor Zephyros came here.

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: That is the chairman's role, actually. Perhaps that's why there seems to be some friction between him and the headmistress.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So all that's left is the academy's main building? That's where Lady Chloris is?

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: Shiina, something terrible has happened!

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: Soleil, what is it?

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: All the energy from the training hall has rushed into the school! W-wait. What is this?

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: Oh! What should we do...? We won't be able to enter the school like this...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Soleil... This feeling is like back then. When we encountered Degos... Don't tell me this curse is...

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: Yes, %s... It is. The energy of the Demon Realm. Why is it hanging over the school?

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: S-Soleil, isn't there anything we can do?

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: There is a way, but... Adventurer!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, Soleil. Tell me what to do.

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: Could you go to Jade and borrow a gem he used to make the Imperial Gate?

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: It can purify or erase traces of the Demon Realm.

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: Please, adventurer. Shiina and I will do everything we can to keep the demonic energy from spreading beyond this hill.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes! I'll be right back. Please be careful...

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: You be careful too, adventurer!

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: Shiina, let's check the hill for now. Make sure nothing else happens...

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: Yes, Soleil! Oh, um... I have a question. Or rather, there's something I don't understand.

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: Why has demonic energy appeared here? I haven't heard of a demon appearing on Xerenis Hill in hundreds of years.

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: ...This is a secret, but I'll tell you, Shiina.

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: Our school has one of the gods' relics: the Windy Seed. Someone is disturbing it now.

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: Oh, that's why Professor Chloris's magic was resonating with an unknown power. I didn't realize it was the relic's power.

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: Soleil, the headmistress will be all right, won't she?

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: She will be. Don't worry too much, Shiina. Let's trust the adventurer.

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: Oh, weren't you going to the festival?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Something suddenly came up. That's why I hurried back to see you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (You tell Jade what happened at the magic academy.)

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: To think something like that happened... I'll look for it right away. Once the component is dismantled, you can use the gem inside.

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: Where did it go? I'm certain there was one left...

lines.speaker: 마법사
lines.text: Jade? Are you looking for the Imperial Gate component?

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: Do you know where it is?

lines.speaker: 마법사
lines.text: I sent it to Archi City for repairs. A messenger has just brought it back.

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: Whew, thank goodness. Soleil knows how to dismantle it, so just give it to her.

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: It's my alma mater. I wish I could go help myself, but I have work to do... I'm sorry.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's all right. Thank you for your help. I'll head straight back to Xerenis.

steps.name: The Academy Festival Ends
steps.objective: Defeat [Chloris] in the "Magic Academy Main Building", then report to [Shiina] in the "Magic Academy Lobby".

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: You're back, adventurer.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (You hand Soleil the Imperial Gate component containing the gem.)

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: This is the component... When Jade said he would build an Imperial Gate, everyone was skeptical.

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: But he did it. Ah, that brought back memories.

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: Soleil, this should push back the demonic energy somewhat.

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: Yes. I'll dismantle it right away.

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: (Energy flows from Soleil's hands and begins taking the component apart. A magic gem radiating a noble light appears within.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What a beautiful, radiant gem.

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: Adventurer, you can enter the main building now.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If I defeat Professor Chloris too, she'll return to normal, right?

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: Yes, but what she's fused with is different from Professor Zephyros's case. You must be even more careful.

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: As I told Shiina, our school holds one of the gods' relics, just as Belpha Library once did.

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: The 'Windy Seed.'

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: It's an artifact of the ancient gods that helps breathe life into the earth. It travels like the wind and makes the land sprout.

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: We don't know exactly how it works... but it possesses powerful magic.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, the Windy Seed...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I think I've heard of it before...)

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: Professor Chloris is probably holding it back herself to keep the students safe.

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: Besides the demonic energy, there's a strange power filling this place. You can feel it too, can't you?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes...

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: That's because Professor Chloris's power and the Windy Seed's are resonating with each other. The seed may be driving her magic out of control...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So this... is Lady Chloris's power.

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: 'Chloris, the genius mage,' acknowledged even by the empress. Something happened at the Magic Bureau, and she came to the school. Oh, that's not important right now.

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: If this continues, no one knows what might happen.

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: Adventurer, please help us once more. We need your power now.

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: Shiina and I will work on clearing away the demonic energy. Please take care of Lady Chloris.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. W-wait...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (An inexplicable sense of foreboding brushes through your entire body.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I'm afraid...)

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: Adventurer, what's wrong?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: N-nothing. I must have imagined it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (...This ominous feeling is like the one I felt from him, inside the divine tree Lapier...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's nothing. I'll go to Lady Chloris right away.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (%s quickens their pace toward the academy's main building.)

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: Does the adventurer know something...? Um, Shiina...

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: Yes, Soleil. What is it?

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: Did your sister know something like this would happen to the adventurer? Is that why she asked us to send the invitation...?

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: Hmm... I don't know that much. Even I don't know everything about my sister.

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: Right now, you and I need to protect the school. %s will do what %s does best... Soleil, my skills may be lacking, but I hope I can help you.

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: Oh, nonsense! Your skills are hardly lacking, Shiina! Anyway, shall we focus and finish this?

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: All right!

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: Soleil! Soleil! The adventurer is back!

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: Really? Oh, adventurer! Are you all right?
(Shiina and Soleil approach, their eyes filled with worry.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm all right. What a relief. The affected students and the school seem to be returning to normal.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But is Lady Chloris all right? She vanished so suddenly, it startled me.

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: Professor Chloris is fine. The Windy Seed that had fused with her has safely returned to its place as well.

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: She looked fine once she returned to normal, but we thought she should still have her condition checked. She left for the imperial capital with Professor Zephyros.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wait... She already got ready and left? She only just returned to normal.

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: No, adventurer. It's been two days since Lady Chloris came out and the school returned to normal.

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: You didn't come out, so Soleil and I kept searching. But we couldn't find you anywhere.

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: Professor Chloris said you would be all right... But what a relief. I'm so glad. We were very worried.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...I did look around a little to check the school's condition before leaving, but two days...?

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: This is only a guess, but I think the demonic energy tried to move into you.

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: I can't be certain. But it's possible if the Windy Seed, freed from Professor Chloris, protected you from that energy.

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: You probably weren't aware of its protection during that time.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Come to think of it... I didn't feel tired at all. During the fight with Lady Chloris, I felt as though I might die...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Was that the Windy Seed's ability...?)

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: Adventurer, thank you again. We'll have to prepare thoroughly to make sure this never happens again.

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: Were we too confident in ourselves? I never imagined the academy could be left defenseless like this...

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: Shiina, I'll look for a solution. Don't worry too much.

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: All right!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Shiina, Soleil... It seems everything is settled now, so I'll be going. I need some rest.

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: You're leaving already?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Someone in Tartaros told me to stay there and rest. If she discovers I'm gone, who knows what she'll do...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So I'll explain the school's situation to Jade, then head straight back.

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: I see. I don't know when, but someday I'll treat you to the Mongle Mongle Guild's delicious desserts.

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: And if you have time later, would you visit again? There's something else I'd like to tell you. I'll be here for a while, so come whenever it's convenient.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I will.

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: Um, adventurer... If I send you another festival invitation later, would you come visit us again?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Of course. If you invite me, I'll be here. Just make sure there isn't another commotion like this one.

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: Hehe. There won't be next time. Travel safely.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. See you again.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I hope that ominous feeling was only my imagination... As soon as I have time, I need to see Iris herself, where she's training.)

steps.name: A Message from the Empress?
steps.objective: Find [Lena Hyren] in the "Silver Shield Tavern".

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: You're back. Thank you for your hard work. I'm sorry. I should have helped too, but something came up...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's all right. Shiina and Soleil were there with me. And we couldn't have done it without your help, Jade.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (You go on to explain that after defeating Chloris, the Windy Seed artifact seemed to keep you briefly in a place untouched by time.)

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: ...Pardon?

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: I had some idea there was an ancient relic at the school, but I'm surprised it has an ability like that.

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: One thing worries me. Demonic energy appearing at a school that houses a relic brings back memories of an earlier incident.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You mean what happened in the garden?

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: Yes. Degos, whom you defeated, tried to use two ancient relics to connect the Demon Realm to this world...

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: Some small openings remain, and demonic energy is seeping through them. But the Empire, Guild Union, religious orders, and other groups are continually finding and sealing them.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's a relief.

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: Still, it's frustrating not knowing how long we'll have to keep doing this.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So to solve it completely...

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: Yes. The goddess you serve will need to become more powerful. I believe it will resolve naturally once she does.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I thought so... I'll keep working hard, too.

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: Everyone knows you're always doing your best, adventurer.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you. Then I'll head back to Eastland. I feel there'll be more work for me soon.

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: If you ever need help, please tell me. We of the Infinite Corridor will spare no effort to assist you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you. Even the offer means a great deal.

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: Oh, there's something I forgot to mention.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What is it?

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: Dame Lena Highren is waiting for you at the Silver Shield Tavern. She says she has brought an imperial decree from Her Majesty for you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wait! From the ruler of the Silvaria Empire?

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: Yes. I don't know what it's about, but I think you should hear her out.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What could it be...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Anyway, I'll go. Thank you, Jade!

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: It's been a while, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Good to see you again, Lena.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: I've been meaning to take you to the imperial palace, but circumstances kept getting in the way. I've only made you wait. A great deal has happened in the Empire too. I'm sorry.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: Her Majesty also sends her apologies about that.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: And to those of you who aren't here but are watching this: sorry for making you wait so long. Your questions will finally start to be answered.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh, Lena? Who are you talking to?

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: Sigh... Her Majesty told me to look off somewhere and say that when I met you. It was an imperial order. I had no choice.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh... Right. Then I suppose it can't be helped.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: Anyway, I've heard you've been busy accomplishing all sorts of things. The girl you were so desperate to find has become a goddess?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. A lot has happened.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: And you've become a hero, not only in Mirgandia but even as far away as Eastland...

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: Impressive. There's a reason Her Majesty keeps an eye on you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I wouldn't go that far... Anyway, I heard you had an imperial decree to deliver to me.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: You must have heard from the Infinite Corridor mage. But what should I do...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What do you mean?

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: Her Majesty clearly told me to give it to %s, but today isn't the appointed day.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The appointed day...?

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: I don't know if you're aware, but Her Majesty can foresee the future. Everyone knows, so there's little point pretending it's a secret.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: Her foresight has prevented grave dangers to the continent. You may not realize it, but you've already resolved several of those dangers yourself.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: She sounds extraordinary, with an ability like that.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: She truly is.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: I'll deliver the decree properly in a few days. Why don't you rest here until then? The Silver Claw will cover your expenses.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: The beer here is the best. I've tried every beer in the capital, and none came close.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I have to go back to Tartaros. If I'm not there, I don't know what might happen.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: Oh, that's already taken care of.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh? How?

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: Her Majesty said she sent an entertaining item to Tartaros and received permission. She also said this matter concerns the goddess, so you would certainly take it on.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What? Am I worth less than some entertaining trinket...?

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: What does it matter? And Lumen seems to think it's fine for you to stay here a little while, too.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But what is this matter concerning Iris? Am I supposed to just wait?

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: It's Her Majesty's order. Please wait.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I can't find out right now, so I'll wait. It's something I'll have to do anyway...

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: Good. Then come back to me on this exact day. I'll deliver Her Majesty's decree then. Hmm, I feel as though there was something else to discuss...

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: Drop by anytime before then. If I remember something, I'll tell you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right, Lena. But you're not going to spend the whole time resting here and drinking beer, are you?

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: How did you know?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Sigh. What a drinker... Go ahead and finish your beer. I'll get some rest too. See you later.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: Yes. Rest well.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: (I don't know what Her Majesty has in mind, but I'm rather looking forward to it.)

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: Oh, my glass is empty. Sera, another ale, please.
